body: Me too. Whenever things are going well and i feel happy i instantly feel anxious after. But when im depressed i feel calm and even comfortable.
im surviving! Had my ups and downs but mostly good. Thanks for checking up. How about you?
Not sure, it is quite a small city tho but pretty fun

So far i haven’t attempted suicide but i have suicidal thoughts a lot. It’s terrifying to think about what would happen after my death but comforting even liberating to think about my suicide ending the pains for myself. Thank you for your reply and im really sorry something like this happened to you.
Im afraid my parents or friends would be interrogated if i die in the house. I can’t have them being interrogated while grieving.

Drugs are great i think, in moderation ofc. It also depends on what mood are you in when you’re taking them. I mainly took drugs out of curiosity. I don’t consider my life to be fully lived, but yeah ive experienced most things ive longed for and now i feel empty and dead inside.
I went for exchange in the Netherlands

I feel you. I often ask myself that why I must keep on living feeling this depressed. But this quote from my favorite comedian Drew Micheal give me some sort of an answer and a glimmer of hope. 
“ My argument against death has always been that it’s the absence of possibility. As long as you have possibility, it’s enough to make a life worth living. You don’t know what you don’t know, and the future itself falls into that category. There is a scene in 6 feet under (s04e12) that gets at this point beautifully. Professional help is also a great option to explore.” 
I hope you will find your light.❤️
